node-1.label: Left scrotal soreness and oedema for five days

node-2.label: Patient is a 13-year-old boy with no lower urinary tract symptoms and no major relevant medical or surgical history

node-3.label: Based on penile characteristics, the patient was diagnosed with occult penis; other congenital anomalies of the genitourinary tract were excluded based on imaging findings

node-4.label: Physical examination revealed an enlarged testis, epididymis, and infected appendages; no torsion was evident in the sperm vessels, but purulent foci were visible on the surface of the vessels with a tough and inseparable texture; the patient was at Tanner stage G4P4

node-11.label: Follow-up Doppler ultrasound reveals a mild whirlpool sign
